transcript.en: As many of you here today have worked in the hotel industry for some time, I'm sure you have experienced the problem of high staff turnover in your hotels.
transcript.zh: 今天在座的的各位当中有许多人都已经在酒店行业工作了一段时间 我相信你们都经历过酒店员工流动率高的问题。

transcript.en: Every hotel relies on having loyal and experienced members of staff who make sure that everything runs smoothly.
transcript.zh: 每家酒店都依赖于拥有忠诚且经验丰富的员工，以便确保一切工作顺利进行。

transcript.en: If staff are constantly changing, it can make life difficult for everyone. But why do staff leave frequently in many hotels?
transcript.zh: 如果酒店员工经常变动，这可能会给大家带来麻烦。但为什么许多酒店的员工经常离职？

transcript.en: Of course, many hotel jobs, such as cleaning, are low-skilled and are not well-paid. A lot of managers think it's this and the long hours that are the main causes of high staff turnover
transcript.zh: 当然，许多酒店工作，例如保洁，都是低技能的而且薪水不高。许多管理者认为，这一因素以及工作时间长是员工流失率高的主要原因

transcript.en: - but what they don't realise is that it's the lack of training in many hotel jobs which is a huge factor.
transcript.zh: 但他们没有意识到，很多酒店工作培训的缺乏也是一个极大的因素。

transcript.en: So, what kind of problems does a high turnover of staff cause? Well, having to recruit new staff all the time can be very time-consuming,
transcript.zh: 那么，员工的高流动性会导致什么样的问题呢？嗯，酒店不得不一直招聘新员工可能会非常耗时

transcript.en: and managers may have to cover some duties while waiting for new staff to arrive.
transcript.zh: 并且管理层可能需要在等待新员工到来时负担一些工作任务。

transcript.en: This means they don't have time to think about less immediate problems such as how to improve their service.
transcript.zh: 这意味着他们没有时间考虑诸如如何改进服务等不太紧迫的问题。

transcript.en: When staff leave, it can also severely affect the colleagues they leave behind. It has a negative effect on remaining staff,
transcript.zh: 当员工离开时，也会严重影响留下来的同事们。这对剩下的员工有负面影响

transcript.en: who may start to feel that they too should be thinking about leaving.
transcript.zh: 他们可能会开始觉得自己也应该考虑离开。

transcript.en: So, what can be done to change this situation? Firstly, managers should stop making basic errors which leave their staff feeling upset and resentful.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们能做些什么来改变这种情况呢？首先，管理者应该停止犯一些会让员工感到沮丧和不满的基本错误。

transcript.en: When organising shifts, for example, make sure you never give certain staff preferential treatment.
transcript.zh: 例如，在安排轮班时，请确保绝不会给予某些员工偏向性待遇。

transcript.en: All staff should be given some choice about when they work, and everyone should have to work some evening and weekend shifts.
transcript.zh: 所有员工都应该在工作时间上有一些自主性选择并且每个人都应该在晚上和周末轮班。

transcript.en: If you treat staff fairly, they'll be more likely to step in and help when extra staff are needed.
transcript.zh: 如果你能公平对待员工，当需要额外人手时，他们才更有可能介入并提供帮助。

transcript.en: Keeping staff happy has other tangible benefits for the business. Take the Dunwich Hotel as an example.
transcript.zh: 让员工开心满意对企业还有其他切实的好处。以Dunwich酒店为例。

transcript.en: It had been experiencing a problem with staff complaints and in order to deal with this, invested in staff training and improved staff conditions.
transcript.zh: 它曾在员工投诉方面遇到过问题，为了应对这一情况该酒店对员工培训和改善工作人员条件等方面进行了投资。

transcript.en: Not only did the level of complaints fall, but they also noticed a significant increase in the amount each customer spent during their stay.
transcript.zh: 不仅投诉数量有所下降 而且他们还注意到每位客户在入住期间的消费量也显著增加。

transcript.en: They have now introduced a customer loyalty scheme which is going really well.
transcript.zh: 他们现在推出了一项客户忠诚度计划，进展非常顺利。

transcript.en: Now I'd like to look at some ways you can reduce staff turnover in your hotels,
transcript.zh: 现在，我们来研究一些可以减少酒店员工流失的方法

transcript.en: and I'll do this by giving some examples of hotels where I've done some training recently.
transcript.zh: 我将举一些我最近进行过培训的酒店的例子。

transcript.en: The Sun Club received feedback which showed that staff thought managers didn't value their opinions.
transcript.zh: Sun Club酒店收到的反馈表明，员工认为管理者们不重视他们的意见。

transcript.en: They weren't made to feel they were partners who were contributing to the success of the business as a whole.
transcript.zh: 没有让他们感受到自己是为企业成功做出贡献的整体的一部分。

transcript.en: This situation has changed. Junior staff at all levels are regularly invited to meetings where their ideas are welcomed.
transcript.zh: 这种情况已经改变。所有级别的初级职员都定期被邀请参加会议，在会上鼓励他们发表自己的想法。

transcript.en: A year ago, The Portland recognised the need to invest in staff retention. Their first step was to introduce a scheme for  recognising talent amongst their employees.
transcript.zh: 一年前，Portland酒店认识到有必要对挽留员工方面进行投资。他们的第一步是推出一项在员工中发掘人才的计划。

transcript.en: The hope is that organising training for individuals with management potential will encourage them to stay with the business.
transcript.zh: 希望为具有管理潜力的个人组织培训，鼓励他们留在企业。

transcript.en: At Bluewater, managers decided to recognise 50 high achievers from across the company's huge hotel chain.
transcript.zh: 在Bluewater酒店，管理者们决定从全公司连锁酒店范围内发掘50位成功人士。

transcript.en: As a reward, they're sent on an all-expenses-paid trip abroad every year. Fun is an important element in the trips, but there's also the opportunity to learn something useful.
transcript.zh: 作为奖励，他们每年可以去国外进行一次费用全包的旅行。乐趣是旅行的一个重要因素 但也有机会学习一些有用的东西。

transcript.en: This year's trip included a visit to a brewery, where staff learned about the new beer that would be served in the hotel.
transcript.zh: 今年的行程包括参观一家啤酒厂 在那里员工可以学习了解将会在酒店供应的新啤酒。

transcript.en: Pentlow Hotels identified that retention of junior reception staff was an issue.
transcript.zh: Pentlow酒店发现留住初级接待人员是一个问题。

transcript.en: In order to encourage them to see that working in a hotel could be worthwhile and rewarding, with good prospects, they introduced a management programme.
transcript.zh: 为了鼓励他们认识到在酒店工作是有价值的、有回报的 前景良好的，他们引入了一项管理计划。

transcript.en: These staff were given additional responsibilities and the chance to work in various roles in the hotel.
transcript.zh: 这些员工被赋予了额外的职责，并有机会在酒店担任不同的职位角色。

transcript.en: Green Planet wanted to be seen as a caring employer.
transcript.zh: Green Planet酒店希望自己被视为一个充满关怀之心的雇主。

transcript.en: To make life easier for staff, many of whom had childcare responsibilities, the hotel began issuing vouchers to help cover the cost of childcare.
transcript.zh: 为了让有育儿责任的员工的生活更轻松 酒店开始发放代金券，以帮助其支付托儿费用。

transcript.en: Louise Marsh at The Amesbury has one of the best staff retention rates in the business.
transcript.zh: The Amesbury酒店的Louise Marsh拥有业内最高的员工留用率。

transcript.en: Since she joined the company, she has made a huge effort to achieve this by creating a co-operative and supportive environment.
transcript.zh: 自从加入公司以来 她付出了巨大的努力去实现这一目标，通过创造合作与支持的环境氛围的方式。

transcript.en: For her, the staff are part of a large family where everyone is valued.OK, now I'd like to ...
transcript.zh: 对她来说，员工是大家庭的一部分，每个人都理应受到重视。好的，现在我想介绍...
